idle.action: Breathe softly and blink, holding half-open map steady. Seamless cycle.

danger.action: Glance down at map then forward, brows concerned, hold map close. Seamless subtle cycle.

success.action: Brighten and point to a place on the map with one finger then settle.

garbage-land.action: Startle briefly, grip map securely and regain balance.

victory.action: Smile and hug the partly unfolded map to chest, finishing with map held happily.

defeat.action: Look down sadly and carefully straighten the map edges, end looking down without recovery.

finish.action: Fold map neatly and breathe out with a gentle satisfied expression.
